system.one_liner: An auditor queries a platform on an audit set; the platform may answer with a manipulated model, so the auditor compares against a prior.

content.variant_note: three parties joined by paired arrows, cut into before, during and after time bands, with circled step callouts
content.argues: A platform can answer the auditor with a manipulated model h_m instead of the model h_p it gives its users, so the auditor must compare h_m(S) to prior knowledge.
content.subject: Platform, users and auditor exchanging queries and answers before, during and after an audit, with three numbered steps.

lessons.what_to_learn: Cut an actor diagram into named time bands with dotted dividers, redraw the same actor in each band with its model state colour-coded, and hang numbered callouts on the actor or link that performs each step.
lessons.suits: Protocols with a few parties and a time order where one party changes behaviour between phases, such as audits, attacks, or privacy and security protocols.

sections: 3 Enhancing Black-box Auditing with a Prior (p.3)

the platform manipulates its answers on the audit set S
hm refers to the model exposed to the auditor (bottom part of Figure 1)

summary: The paper studies how a regulator can audit an ML platform without being fooled when the platform manipulates its answers. Figure 1 draws the three-step audit as an actor diagram cut into three time bands by dotted lines: before, during and after the audit. At top the Platform serves model h_p to Users; below, the Platform shows h_m to the Auditor. Heavy paired arrows carry queries and answers (x, h_p(x), S, h_m(S)), a thought bubble marks audit set generation, a curved arrow marks the swap from h_p to h_m, and a callout marks the comparison with the auditor's prior ℋ_a. Green and maroon separate the real from the manipulated model; server, people and scales icons name the three parties.
summary_zh: 论文研究监管者如何审计可能篡改答案的机器学习平台。图一用虚线把三步审计分成审计前、中、后三段：平台对用户给出 h_p，对审计者给出被篡改的 h_m；圆圈编号标出生成审计集、篡改、与先验比较，绿与深红区分真假模型。
notes: Prior kinds kept (actor-interaction, stage-pipeline) with variant multi-party-exchange; the three bands are time lanes, not panels. The meaning of the script D beside the users is not stated in the quoted text. The text layer carries only the box titles and the step digits; formulas and callout wording are not live text and were read from the preview.
